name: plugin.rea_mobile_firmware
description: REA Android APK static inspection, JADX decompilation, reference tracing, discrete ADB device bridging, and Linux Binwalk/Unblob firmware carving.

entrypoints.name: rea_mobile_apk_inspect
entrypoints.description: Inspect APK manifest, package identity, permissions, SDK levels, and component counts.

parameters.name: decode_resources
parameters.description: Whether to decode resources via Apktool

entrypoints.name: rea_mobile_jadx_decompile
entrypoints.description: Decompile Dalvik bytecode into Java/Smali source trees via headless JADX.

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Optional destination directory for decompiled files

entrypoints.name: rea_mobile_android_search_classes
entrypoints.description: Search decompiler class names by case-sensitive substring.

entrypoints.name: rea_mobile_android_trace_references
entrypoints.description: Trace static incoming references to a class or unique method across the decompiled APK.

parameters.name: method_name
parameters.description: Optional method name within target class

entrypoints.name: rea_mobile_adb_inspect_client
entrypoints.description: Report resolved adb binary path, version, and install source without contacting devices.

entrypoints.name: rea_mobile_adb_list_devices
entrypoints.description: Enumerate attached devices and emulators with state, model, and serial metadata.

entrypoints.name: rea_mobile_adb_list_packages
entrypoints.description: List installed packages on one device with base APK paths.

parameters.name: device_serial
parameters.description: Target device serial number (optional if only one device connected)

entrypoints.name: rea_mobile_adb_pull_package
entrypoints.description: Pull a device-installed APK to a local path.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Local destination directory or file path

entrypoints.name: rea_mobile_adb_read_logcat
entrypoints.description: Bounded adb logcat dump for a given buffer and optional tag filter.

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Logcat buffer name: main, system, crash, events, radio

parameters.name: max_lines
parameters.description: Maximum number of lines to dump (default: 500)

entrypoints.name: rea_firmware_regions_inspect
entrypoints.description: Scan binary with Binwalk 3.1.0 for signature candidates (Linux-only).

parameters.name: firmware_path
parameters.description: Path to raw firmware image file

entrypoints.name: rea_firmware_extract
entrypoints.description: Unpack embedded partitions via Unblob 26.6.4 into structured file trees (Linux-only).

parameters.name: firmware_path
parameters.description: Path to raw firmware image file

parameters.name: destination_dir
parameters.description: Destination directory for extracted partition contents
